introHtml: Raglan baseball sleeves offer a classic athletic look that stands out from standard set-in sleeves. The contrasting sleeve color and roomier fit make these products ideal for team uniforms, company sports leagues, or promotional giveaways at sporting events. Whether you choose short or long sleeves, the raglan style provides comfort and a vintage feel that employees and customers appreciate. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a polished finish.
